MIND. [1] [Fl. ac.]
Great loss of memory ; forgets almost everything.
Mental weakness. θ Ascites.
Feeling of indifference towards those he loves best, has no objection to their presence but does not care to converse with them, yet it strangers or mere acquaintances come in will enter into animated conversation.
Gay disposition, everything is satisfactory.
Excessive hilarity ; great buoyancy of mind, happy, serene.
Greatly depressed in mind. θ Ascites.
Anxiety. θ Ascites.
Very ill humored. θ Ascites.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Fl. ac.]
Congestion of blood mostly to forehead, with dulness in occiput toward night.
Feeling as if in an earthquake.
Sensation of weakness, like numbness in head, same in hands.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Fl. ac.]
Severe pressing in both temples, from within outward.
Compressing pain in temples.
Headache in sutures behind ears at 3 P. M.
Headache accompanied by congestion of blood to head, sensation of numbness, with heaviness and compressive pains.
Dull, heavy headache. θ Dyspepsia.
Congestive headache.
Dullness of occiput ; towards right in occiput.
Pressure on both sides of occiput.
Headache in occiput, with fulness in head.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Fl. ac.]
Sensation of numbness in forehead.
Pain along the sutures.
Itching of head ; baldness.
Congestion of blood to scalp ; hair becomes dry, breaks off and falls out.
Falling off of hair.
Hair falling out after typhoid fever.
Alopecia areata.
Must comb hair frequently, it mats so at the end. θ Pica polonica.
Scaly eruptions on head.
Crusta lactea, dry, scaly, itches very much, makes bald.
Caries of temporal bone, discharging offensive-smelling pus periodically ; whole left side of head retarded in growth, left eye seems smaller.
Syphilitic caries of bones of skull.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Fl. ac.]
Heaviness above eyes, with nausea ; < on motion.
Pressure, as if behind right ball.
Sensation as of a cold wind blowing under lids, even in a warm room, must tie them up and keep them warm.
Sensation of sand in eyes, or as if a fresh wind was blowing on them.
Chronic ophthalmia ; feeling of sand in eye, must wink constantly.
Feeling as if he must wink, as if something was in eye that could be rubbed out.
Increased lachrymation.
Itching in canthi.
Fistula lachrymalis.
Lachrymal fistula on left side, of one year's duration ; a clear yellow scab on cheek near inner angle, which is but slightly red and painful to pressure ; every three or four days it begins to itch and grow moist, then heals again ; sometimes painful before it opens.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Fl. ac.]
Great sensitiveness in morning to little noises.
Hardness of hearing with rheumatism ; constant disagreeable ringing in ears and sensation of numbness in bones of face around right ear.
Difficulty in hearing human voices ; numbness of bones around ear.
Singing in ears.
Ringing in ears and numb feeling in bones of face near r. ear.
Intolerable itching in both ears.
Itching momentarily > from scratching, but followed by burning.
Otorrhœa ; discharge copious.
Otitis externa ; chronic diffuse otitis.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Fl. ac.]
Fluent coryza.
Posterior nares feel expanded, during a walk.
Chronic nasal catarrh, with ulceration of septum.
Pimple on left wing of nose perforated and left an opening as large as a pea.
Red, swollen, inflamed nose. θ Rhinitis.
Itching on right side of nose.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Fl. ac.]
Pale face.
Heat in face, wants to wash it with cold water.
Tubercles in skin of forehead and face, suppurating. θ Syphilis infantum.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Fl. ac.]
Right lower jaw swollen.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Fl. ac.]
The teeth feel warm (felt side, upper jaw).
Heaviness of the teeth.
Great sensitiveness of teeth ; cannot be plugged.
Toothache < from cold drink ; or > until water becomes warm in mouth.
Mouth and teeth coated with mucus in morning.
Violent pains at root of right eye-tooth, with frequent discharge of pus.
Fistula at root of tooth, or of gum ; teeth exceedingly sensitive.
Acrid, foul taste from roots of teeth.
Rapid caries of teeth.
The teeth come late in children ; wisdom teeth come late.
Great sensitiveness to pressure on gum over right eye-tooth. θ Fistula dentalis.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Fl. ac.]
Acrid foul taste from roots of teeth.
Tongue always more or less tender, feeling of rigidity in it, with restricted mobility. θ Secondary syphilis.
Tongue painful when talking.
Tingling and numbness of tongue.
Tongue vivid red at tip and edges, coated yellow in centre.
Tongue whitish and dry. θ Ascites.
Tongue deeply and widely fissured in all directions, with a large, deep, phagedenic looking ulcer in centre.
Ulcer on and under tongue.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Fl. ac.]
Increased flow of saliva ; with sneezing ; with pricking of tongue.
Mouth and teeth are full of mucus, in morning.
Teeth and mouth covered with dark mucus. θ Typhus.
A very painful little ulcer in back part of mouth, on right side, in angle of upper and lower jaw ; very troublesome during mastication and otherwise.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Fl. ac.]
Constriction in throat with difficult deglutition ; in the morning, hawking of phlegm mixed with blood.
Red blotches, size of half pea, over palate and sides of cheeks, bleeding easily.
Tonsils, uvula and soft palate of a livid red color, and greatly swollen.
Excessive suffering on swallowing or talking.
Sleep disturbed by accumulation of mucus in fauces.
Throat irritable and peculiarly sensitive to cold, slightest exposure resulting in inflammatory action with increase of pain and impeded deglutition.
Syphilitic affections of fauces and tongue.
Soft palate and uvula intensely red and much tumefied ; breath fetid, voice nasal, articulation indistinct and unintelligible. θ Secondary syphilis.
Ulceration of uvula a portion of which seems only attached by a thread ; ulceration of nose ; fetid smell from nose and mouth ; hardness of hearing ; stubborn exanthema.
Chronic catarrhal inflammation of pharynx and fauces, with ptyalism : especially if syphilitic.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Fl. ac.]
Hunger predominates ; great appetite in evening.
Loss of appetite. θ Dropsy.
Speedy satiety.
Thirst ; craves refreshing drinks.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Fl. ac.]
After eating salmon. θ Bilious diarrhœa.
During the day, mainly soon after drinking, especially warm drinks, such as tea, cocoa, beef tea, bilious diarrhœa.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Fl. ac.]
Nausea and eructations, with lassitude.
Heartburn and offensive smelling eructations.
Frequent eructations and discharge of flatulency.
Sickness and nausea, combined with general heat and heat at stomach.
Bilious vomiting : after slight errors in diet ; with increased alvine discharges, preceded by tormina. θ Chronic diarrhœa.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Fl. ac.]
Feeling of fulness and pressure in epigastrium. θ Dropsy.
Feeling of weight in stomach between meals.
Heat in stomach before a meal.
Chronic gastritis.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Fl. ac.]
Sensitive to pressure in right hypochondrium.
Pressing pain in region of spleen and left arm.
Pinching in region of spleen.
Skin pale, grayish, dry ; emaciation ; great weakness, can hardly walk across room ; mind impaired ; anorexia ; tongue white and dry ; fulness and pressure in epigastrium ; great tension and dropsical swelling of abdomen ; stools tardy and hard ; scanty, dark-red urine ; painful urination ; scrotum swollen as large as a child's head ; penis S shaped and terribly swollen, prepuce so œdematous as to completely hide orifice of urethra ; dry cough with occasional frothy expectoration ; dyspnœa, can only lie in an elevated position ; anxiety ; sleeps little and but for a short time ; violent, unquenchable thirst ; longs for refreshing drinks ; great œdema of lower limbs, extending from feet to abdomen ; great depression of spirits ; pulse small and frequent ; speech listless ; liver enlarged and indurated, particularly left lobe. θ Affection of liver with dropsy.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Fl. ac.]
Sensation of emptiness in region of navel, with desire to take a deep breath ; > from bandaging or tightening the clothing.
Great tension and dropsical swelling of abdomen.
Ascites from hepatic disorder.
Ascites from enlarged and indurated liver, in consequence of drinking whisky.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Fl. ac.]
Frequent passage of flatus, and belching, with constriction of anus.
Stools pappy, yellowish-brown, fetid, with tenesmus and prolapsus ani.
Very loose, bright yellow stools, with a quantity of mucus, preceded by considerable griping.
Bilious diarrhœa < during day, soon after drinking, especially warm drinks.
Diarrhœa and bilious vomiting.
Tongue vivid red at tip and margins and coated yellow in centre ; appetite good ; evacuations never less than twice a day of liquid, bilious fecal matter, intermixed with frothy mucus ; no griping and no tenesmus ; some sensibility to external pressure in right hypochondrium ; face pale ; muscles soft and flabby ; bilious vomiting after trivial errors in diet, with aggravation of the diarrhœa, stools on such occasions being preceded by tormina. θ Chronic looseness of bowels and bilious vomiting.
Six to eight evacuations in twenty-four hours, consisting of "very loose, bright yellow matter and a quantity of mucus," each relief being preceded by considerable griping ; dejections occur chiefly during night, or early in morning ; during day the mainly occur soon after drinking, especially warm fluids. θ Bilio-mucous diarrhœa.
Tardy, infrequent and hard stools. θ Dropsy.
Constipation, with great varicosis of hemorrhoidal veins.
Copious hemorrhage after constipated stool.
Protrusion of anus during defecation.
Itching within and around anus, in perineum.
Pruritus ani.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Fl. ac.]
Frequent and free discharge of light-colored urine, with increased thirst.
Involuntary discharge of urine in night.
Urine scanty and dark, painful in passing. θ Dropsy.
Urine alkaline.
Whitish or purple-colored sediment.
Burning before and after urination, with aching in bladder.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Fl. ac.]
Satyriasis.
Sexual passion increased, with erections at night during sleep.
Sexual passion strong, with violent erections all night, and desire to cohabit.
Highly excessive enjoyment and pleasure during coition, which was not the case before.
Seminal discharge not so quick and early as usual, but free and without any bad after-feeling.
Increased sexual desire in old men, with violent erections at night.
Sudden loss of sexual power ; impotence.
Yellow drop from urethra in morning.
Gleety discharge at night, staining linen yellow.
Fulness of glans penis and lower part of scrotum.
Dropsical swelling of penis.
Hydrocele.
Oily, pungent smelling sweat on genitals.
Gonorrhœa.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Fl. ac.]
Nymphomania.
Obstinate cases of ulcerated os uteri ; sharp, darting pains about half an inch in length, like streaks of lightning.
Too frequent appearance of menses.
Menses too early ; too copious ; blood thick and coagulated.
Leucorrhœa acrid, excoriating, with itching.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Fl. ac.]
Itching, redness and swelling of right nipple.
Nipples very red, sore and cracked.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Fl. ac.]
Goitre.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Fl. ac.]
Difficult breathing, afternoon and evening.
Wheezing respiration. θ Hydrothorax.
Great dyspnœa, has to be propped up in bed. θ Ascites.
   

COUGH. [27] [Fl. ac.]
Short, frequent cough, mostly dry, occasionally some whitish, frothy, mucous expectoration. θ Dropsy.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Fl. ac.]
Phthisis pulmonalis.
Dropsy of chest ; pulse frequent, small and often irregular ; cannot lie down ; dyspnœa.
Hydrothorax.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Fl. ac.]
Sore pain at heart ; soreness and jerking.
Small, frequent pulse. θ Dropsy.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Fl. ac.]
Scaly eruption on chest and arms.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Fl. ac.]
Pain in third cervical vertebra.
Pain from nape of neck, extending through centre of head to forehead.
Rigidity of nape.
Bruised pain in sacrum.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Fl. ac.]
Pain in right shoulder-joint ; shoulder-joints stiffened by rheumatism.
Pain in right shoulder-joint extending towards fingers, as if air was passing down.
Rheumatism, especially venereal ; arms and shoulders are very lame and painful.
Rheumatic pains in left arm, from shoulder to elbow, with lameness.
Slight lameness in right arm ; has some difficulty in writing.
Numbness and powerlessness of hands.
Constant redness of hands, especially palms.
Burning in hands.
Heat and sweat of palms of hands ; moist palms regain their healthy condition.
Acute pricking, as with needles, in fingers.
Pain in left index finger, as if bone, now and then during day ; whole finger painful internally, particularly in evening.
First and second phalanx of left index finger swollen to four times natural size ; first phalanx particularly swollen so that finger is pear-shaped ; on dorsum of finger an opening occasionally occurs from which an ichorous, purulent discharge takes place.
Whitlow.
Panaritium ; also simple onychia, ulceration having set in.
Nails grow more rapidly ; crumpled, or longitudinal ridges in them.
Sharp sticking pain at root of right thumb nail.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Fl. ac.]
Acute stitches in right hip-bone.
Lameness in left hip.
Coxalgia.
Œdematous swelling of legs up to abdomen. θ Ascites.
Left leg goes "to sleep" easily.
Varicosis of lower limbs.
Varicose veins upon legs, tend to ulceration.
Pain in right knee-joint.
Synovitis of knee-joint ; much pain, followed by dropsy.
Top of foot œdematous ; instep.
Chronic ulcerations on feet, particularly about joints and on tibia ; bones more or less affected.
Burning stitches in soles.
Feet hot and burn much.
Soreness between toes.
Soreness of all the corns.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Fl. ac.]
Pain in all the limbs, with weakness and numbness.
Limbs go to sleep, although he does not lie on them.
Feet and hands excessively moist.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Fl. ac.]
Many symptoms < when standing, though > when standing than when sitting.
   

NERVES. [36] [Fl. ac.]
Increased ability to exercise his muscles without fatigue ; is less affected by excessive heat in summer or cold in winter.
Sensation of going to sleep of side not lain on.
Limbs go to sleep, although he does not lie on them.
Lassitude.
Great diurnal languor. θ Secondary syphilis.
Loss of strength ; great prostration and fear of death.
Coccyodynia, with excessive aching, especially in rheumatic subjects.
Tabes dorsalis with great excitement of sexual system.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Fl. ac.]
Drowsiness.
Sleep earlier in evening ; sudden sleepiness.
Loss of sleep in evening, from crowding of thoughts.
Sleeplessness, without inclination to sleep ; a short sleep suffices and refreshes him.
Sleep restless and unrefreshing. θ Dropsy.
Dreams towards morning.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Fl. ac.]
Worse in wet, cold weather.
   

FEVER. [40] [Fl. ac.]
Chill entirely wanting.
General heat, with nausea from slightest motion, with inclination to uncover, and to wash with cold water.
Heat returns every evening with frequent pulse and thirst, lasting 3 to 4 hours. θ Intermittent.
Decubitus. θ Typhoid fever.
Clammy, sour and unpleasant smelling sweat, mostly on upper body, particularly during exercise in afternoon and evening.
Heat and sweat of palms of hands.
The sweat promotes excoriation and decubitus.
Better during sweat.
Symptoms following typhus fever.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Fl. ac.]
Symptoms seem to go from below up.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Fl. ac.]
Emaciation. θ Dropsy.
Muscles soft and flabby. θ Chronic diarrhœa.
Alopecia.
Goitre.
Liver enlarged and indurated.
Dropsy of drunkards.
Acute suppurations.
Threatening gangrene in swollen scrotum and penis.
Varicose veins of legs.
Nevus, flat.
Varicose veins, obstinate and long standing cases, especially in women who have borne many children.
Varicose ulcers.
Pains in the bones.
Swelling of bones.
Osteitis.
Exostoses and nightly pains in bones.
Diseases of bones, particularly of long bones ; suppurate and get better and worse periodically ; pains < at night, with great prostration.
Diseases of bones ; particularly of long bones ; caries and necrosis, especially when they are of a psoric or syphilitic nature ; or from abuse of mercury.
Syphilis.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Fl. ac.]
Decubitus. θ Typhus.
   

SKIN. [46] [Fl. ac.]
Skin grayish-white. θ Dropsy.
Burning pains on small spots of skin.
Itching of skin.
Sensation as if a burning vapor was emitted from the pores of the whole body.
Elevated red blotches.
Skin tubercles on forehead and face, even when ulcerating ; elevated red blotches on palm of hands ; squamous eruptions on body (psoriasis guttata) ; syphilitic erosions, mucous tubercles ; exostoses and nightly pains in bones.
Dry cutaneous eruptions.
Squamous eruptions on body.
Nevus of children (on right temple) ; capillary aneurism.
Erosions, mucous tubercles.
Varicose veins and ulcers.
Ulcers : painful ; < from warmth, > from cold ; with copious discharge ; with red borders and vesicles.
Old cicatrices become red around edges, covered or surrounded by itching vesicles or they itch violently.
Bedsores ; nevi materni ; pimples.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Fl. ac.]
Complaints of old age, also premature old age, in consequence of syphilitic-mercurial dyscrasia.
Weakly constitutions, sallow skin, emaciation.
Secondary syphilis ; syphilis infantum.
